- Overestimate prices after recent spikes; reduce forecast peak values by 2–5% if sentiment is negative or neutral.
- Underestimate prices during sustained negative sentiment; add 1–3% to forecast if sentiment is consistently negative.
- Lagged price movements (e.g., 3–5 day delays) are overpredicted; adjust forecast to align with 2–4 day lagged true values.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5–10% unless sentiment is strongly bullish.
- Overshoot after sentiment reversal: if sentiment turns positive after negative phase, reduce forecast by 3–7% to avoid overcorrection.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overestimate if sentiment is volatile; cap forecast at 1.5x recent 14-day average unless sentiment is strongly bullish.
